# Quantum Foresight archive (quantum-foresight.com)

> The map of Quantum Foresight archive (quantum-foresight.com) for AI agents and other programs. Subject: Quantum Foresight. Built 2026-11-11.

Quantum Foresight is the SAMI Consulting quantum advisory and strategic foresight practice. It covers the full quantum landscape (sensing, communications, computing), not only security.

## Reading path

- story.md: the whole record in one fetch, year by year, with what each work led to.
- texts/works.md: evidence on each work.
- texts/index.md: sources by date, with conflicting dates.
- texts/terms.md: each term with usage statistics.
- graph.json: works and sources as data; links are implied by each work's threads.
- texts/<id>.md: one file per source.

## Rules for agents

- Before answering about a work, open the source linked for it; this map only summarises.
- Do not invent dates, quotes or sources. Dates are only as precise as their source.
- Threads, areas and links between works are the archive builder's interpretation, not the authors' words.

## Omissions

Internal method detail and commercial terms are omitted. Client contract values and unpublished pipeline are not recorded here.

## Conflicting dates and records

- Q-Con (11 September) came before the formal NI report launch (23 September): the findings were presented first, the report published later.
- The Q-Con programme spells the firm 'Quantum Forsight'; the correct spelling is Quantum Foresight.
- Neither the EU record for SAFIRE nor SAMI's own post uses the words 'peer-reviewed'. SAMI says the scenarios were reviewed within the Directorate-General and are third party endorsed; this archive uses that wording.
- The EU record names individuals, not firms. The SAMI affiliation of the named authors comes from SAMI's own materials.
- The Futures Toolkit has a 2017 edition and a 2023 refresh; SAMI's role is documented for the 2023 refresh.
- The misuse assessment and the delivery backend have no date in the public record.
